adaptive_lenc_merge.claim: Published adaptive-lattice multiplication identity holds exactly in the finite toy.

direct_affine_universalization.claim: Exact affine x-coefficients expose r via r^T G because gadget blocks start with 1.

fully_succinct_state.claim: Recursive succinctness retains a final private encoder-evaluation state.

half_succinct_ote.claim: With E and phi public, basis x reconstructs encoder input y in the exact zero-noise algebra.

public_completion.claim: A public replacement for the missing encoder share on arbitrary x makes x tensor y public; basis x reveals y.

scope: Algebra/syntax controls only; no LWE security is inferred.
Direct affine leakage does not rule out every conceivable witness-independent compiler.
Public-completion barrier applies when encoder input y is intended to remain secret.
Published paper quantifies PPT, not QPT, attackers.
